items: Only 13 effective clusters support refinement analysis.
The 52 rankable queries are an already-inspected benchmark, not a fresh holdout.
Eight queries remain excluded from full ranking metrics and 96 insufficient judgments remain missing.
District proxies dominate; coordinate results are not representative.
No candidate is approved from same-benchmark improvement alone.
Historical seasonality is neither live weather nor safety certification.
